name: Jury Rigg
abilities: Disassembles any machine (even Rex's builds, living Chronosapiens) in seconds
Builds complex machinery from scratch just as fast
Repairs and modifies technology (built the Tenn-Speed, reprogrammed the Highbreed Pulse Generator)
Enhanced strength for his size (broke bars Rath could not)
weaknesses: Near-uncontrollable compulsion to break and rebuild machines
Head-sized body is useless in hand-to-hand combat against large foes
summary: A head-sized red gremlin who cannot stop taking machines apart - and can rebuild them into anything just as fast.
traits: About the size of a human head
Turned Will Harangue into an alien as payback
Wears an aviator outfit in Omniverse
notableFeats: Dismantled then rebuilt Dr. Animo's mutant ray to stop the pterodactyl (The Eggman Cometh)
Rebuilt the Proto-TRUK and created the Tenn-Speed (Rules of Engagement)
Disabled the Highbreed Pulse Generator and reprogrammed it to mutate Will Harangue (Return to Forever)

appearances.designNotes: Small reddish-orange gremlin with four-fingered hands, three-toed feet, devil-like tail, pointed ears; Ultimatrix symbol on chest.

appearances.designNotes: Smoother crimson skin, aviator outfit with ascot and goggles, black pupils, spiked ears, protruding teeth, bigger nose, chin and eye spikes; Omnitrix on waist.

scoring.rationale: A tech saboteur, not a fighter: shreds or rebuilds any machine in seconds (special 6, intellect 8) and once neutralised a planet-scale Highbreed weapon. Tiny, easily swatted, and his compulsion to break things makes him hard for Ben to steer (controlPenalty 2).

notes: UA wearer: Ultimatrix; OV: new Omnitrix.
